admins.description: List of Gitolite admin usernames. Admins have full read/write/ssh access to all repositories, including the gitolite-admin repo.

repositories.description: List of repositories to create/secure. Each entry defines a repo name and optional access groups.

mirrors.description: List of repositories to mirror using Gitolite’s mirroring feature. Requires Gitolite v3.6+ and the 'mirror' plugin enabled.

hooks.description: List of repositories requiring custom Gitolite config (e.g., hooks, branch restrictions).
